articles.summary: Archived April 2026 product note. Webhound now uses Hound, a research harness whose effort is controlled by budget rather than a model or mode picker.
articles.title: Going back to a composer-first home

articles.summary: People who do work where truth matters don't trust AI. They spend more time verifying than the AI saves them. For three months we've been focused on one question: how do you build AI research people can actually trust.
articles.title: How we think about truth, verification, and "time to first trust" at Webhound
